uncited: **Sheet Buffer:** A 2D array (texture or render target) matching the screen resolution.
**Sheet Alignment:** Determine the volume axis ($x, y,$ or $z$) most parallel to the image plane.
**Splat Transformation:** Transform splat centers from volume space to screen space.
*   Rasterize all splats assigned to sheet $k$ onto the sheet buffer.
**Compositing:** Traverse the sheet buffers in depth order (back-to-front for opacity).
**Output:** The cache image is the final rendered image.
